title: Governance lifecycle stages, bias and fairness tests, and multiple project dashboards

body_markdown:
Define the lifecycle stages a project moves through, assign reviewers to each stage, and get warned when an earlier stage's requirements stop being met. Three new built-in frameworks cover NYDFS Circular Letter No. 7, Colorado Regulation 10-1-1, and the NAIC AI Model Bulletin, and any framework now exports as an audit-ready compliance report.


[Read the docs →](https://www.openlayer.com/docs/governance/project-lifecycle)


## Bias and fairness tests


Four new test types check protected groups and their intersections for disparities in outcomes, scores, performance, and metrics. Each result opens with an Analysis tab of charts you can drill into and export to CSV.


[Read the docs →](https://www.openlayer.com/docs/tests/catalog/bias)


## Multiple project dashboards


Give each project as many dashboards as you need. Start from the default layout or a blank one, rename, duplicate, choose who can see each one, and switch between them from the breadcrumb or ⌘K. Dashboards also carry new mode-aware usage, cost, and judge-cost widgets.


## Also new this quarter


- **EU data region.** Choose United States or European Union when you sign in or sign up, and your account and data stay in that region.[Learn more →](https://www.openlayer.com/docs/security/data-residency)
- **AI usage and security data sources.** Monitor how your organization uses AI with usage logs from OpenAI Compliance Logs, the Claude Compliance API, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and CrowdStrike Falcon Guardian.[Learn more →](https://www.openlayer.com/docs/integrations/overview)
- **Agent platform tracing.** Native tracing for ElevenLabs voice agents (with an audio view), Snowflake Cortex Agents, Databricks AI/BI Genie, and Palantir Foundry AIP Agents and Logic.[Learn more →](https://www.openlayer.com/docs/integrations/overview)
- **Custom columns.** Name a JSONPath into your structured outputs once and use it in tests, filters, and tables across the project.[Learn more →](https://www.openlayer.com/docs/monitoring/custom-columns)
- **Freshness tests.** Get alerted when a data source stops receiving data or a datetime column gets too old.[Learn more →](https://www.openlayer.com/docs/tests/catalog/freshness)
- **Gateway upgrades.** Routing by deployment, group, user, or key, model allow and block lists,` /v1/models` and` /v1/embeddings` endpoints, and multi-replica high availability.[Learn more →](https://www.openlayer.com/docs/gateway/overview)
- **API key expiry and MCP permissions.** Set expiry dates and rotate API keys automatically, and connect the remote MCP server with Full or Read-only access managed from a Connected Apps page.[Learn more →](https://www.openlayer.com/docs/workspace-and-projects/find-your-api-key)
